question: The HCF of two numbers is 20 and their LCM is 2880. If one of the numbers is 180, then the other number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any two numbers, the product of the numbers is equal to the product of their HCF and LCM.

⇒ Second Number = (HCF × LCM) ÷ First Number

⇒ Second Number = (20 × 2880) ÷ 180

⇒ Second Number = 57600 ÷ 180 = 320

**∴ The correct answer is 320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

HCF of the two numbers = 20

LCM of the two numbers = 2880

First number = 180

**Formula Used:**

First Number × Second Number = HCF × LCM

**Calculations:**

⇒ 180 × Second Number = 20 × 2880

⇒ 180 × Second Number = 57600

⇒ Second Number = 57600 ÷ 180

⇒ Second Number = 320

**∴ The correct answer is 320.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Product Rule for Two Numbers

The product of any two numbers is always exactly equal to the product of their Highest Common Factor (HCF) and Least Common Multiple (LCM). Formula: N₁ × N₂ = HCF × LCM.

Co-prime Numbers

If two numbers are co-prime, their HCF is always 1. For such numbers, their LCM is simply the direct product of the two numbers.

HCF and LCM of Fractions

HCF of fractions = (HCF of Numerators) ÷ (LCM of Denominators). LCM of fractions = (LCM of Numerators) ÷ (HCF of Denominators).
